crossRefs.note: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in…
The strong among the mighty will speak to him out of the middle of Sheol with those who help him. They have gone down.…
The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died, and was buried.

translations.web: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.
translations.bsb: He is carried to the grave, and watch is kept over his tomb.
translations.kjv: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.
translations.asv: Yet shall he be borne to the grave, And men shall keep watch over the tomb.
